meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord about the broken heating and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes: to, subject and body fields filled in, a tone switch between polite and firm that rewrites the body, and send and discard buttons. Sending needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows it as sent.
meta.text:
state to="landlord@example.com"
state subject="Heating not working in my flat"
state tone="polite"
state body="Hi,\n\nI hope you're well. The heating in my flat has stopped working, and with the colder weather it's becoming difficult to stay comfortable. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look as soon as possible?\n\nI'm happy to give access at a time that suits. Thank you for your help.\n\nKind regards"
state status="draft"
Card w:390 gap:12
  if status=="draft"
    Row between middle
      Text.heading "Email draft"
      Badge.info "Draft"
    SegmentedButton =tone items:["polite","firm"] -> body=tone=="polite"?"Hi,\n\nI hope you're well. The heating in my flat has stopped working, and with the colder weather it's becoming difficult to stay comfortable. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look as soon as possible?\n\nI'm happy to give access at a time that suits. Thank you for your help.\n\nKind regards":"Hello,\n\nThe heating in my flat is broken and has not been working. This is a repair you are responsible for, and it needs to be fixed urgently. Please confirm within 48 hours when an engineer will attend.\n\nIf I don't hear back, I will have to consider my options and escalate the matter.\n\nRegards"
    Input "To" "landlord@example.com" =to
    Input "Subject" =subject
    Input "Body" =body lines:8
    if to==""||subject==""
      Text.danger "Add a recipient and a subject to send."
    Row gap:8 end
      Button.ghost "Discard" -> status="discarded"; emit discard
      Button "Send" enabled:=to!=""&&subject!="" -> status="sent"; emit send; toast "Email sent"
  if status=="sent"
    Row gap:8 middle
      Icon "check_circle"
      Text.heading "Sent"
      Badge.success "Sent"
    Text.strong "{subject}"
    Text.muted "To: {to}"
    Text.body "{body}"
  if status=="discarded"
    Row between middle
      Text.heading "Draft discarded"
      Badge.neutral "Discarded"
    Button.outline "Restore draft" -> status="draft"
